title: Orient the scale
text: The 0-cm end of the stick is at the floor, so cm readings increase toward the ceiling. The net displacement of $$-32\, \text{cm}$$ (in the $$\hat{u}$$ sense) is $$32$$ cm toward the ceiling - toward higher cm readings.

title: Final position formula
text: Final position $$=$$ $$100$$ cm + $$32$$ cm (toward the ceiling) $$=$$ $$132$$ cm.
